name: loomascale
description: LoomaScale plugins for Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook Ads and Instagram Ads), TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and Google Merchant Center, including competitor analysis and ad research.

plugins.name: loomascale
plugins.description: Audit Google Ads, Meta Ads and TikTok Ads with LoomaScale. Compare TikTok video performance and preview budget or bid changes for approval. Manage Google and Meta campaigns, research Google Ads keywords and compare competitors' public Google, Facebook and Instagram ads by creative, message, offer and disclosed landing page. Review performance and conversion tracking with LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Search Console (GSC) and Google Merchant Center (GMC).
plugins.displayName: Google Ads, Meta Ads & TikTok Ads MCP by LoomaScale

plugins.name: loomascale-meta
plugins.description: Audit Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) spend, delivery and creatives, research the Ad Library, and change campaigns only on request.

plugins.name: loomascale-metapixel
plugins.description: Check Meta Pixel and Conversions API health: which pixels fire, browser vs server event counts, Event Match Quality and Meta's fixes. Read-only.

plugins.name: loomascale-tiktokpixel
plugins.description: Check TikTok Pixel and Events API health: browser vs server event counts, attributed events and TikTok's tracking diagnostics. Read-only.

plugins.name: loomascale-tiktok
plugins.description: Audit TikTok Ads spend, video creatives and audiences, diagnose delivery and ad review, and preview budget or bid changes for your approval.

plugins.name: loomascale-linkedin
plugins.description: Audit and manage LinkedIn Ads: campaign and creative reports, leads by job title, seniority and industry, wasted spend, and previewed changes you approve.

plugins.name: loomascale-keywords
plugins.description: Research Google Ads keywords with Keyword Planner data: new keyword ideas, search volume, bid ranges, campaign forecasts and ad group fit. Read-only.

plugins.name: loomascale-adlibrary
plugins.description: Research competitors' public Google, Facebook and Instagram ads in the Google Ads Transparency Center and Meta Ad Library. No ad account needed. Read-only.

plugins.name: loomascale-youtube
plugins.description: Report and run YouTube ads through Google Ads: views, view rate, cost per view and conversions by surface, paused Demand Gen launches and approved changes.

plugins.name: loomascale-ga4
plugins.description: Analyze Google Analytics 4 traffic, conversions, revenue and funnels. Change key events and stream settings after a dry run and your approval.

plugins.name: loomascale-gtm
plugins.description: Audit Google Tag Manager conversion tracking, draft workspace fixes, and publish only a container version you confirm.

plugins.name: loomascale-gsc
plugins.description: Google Search Console SEO analysis: compare organic traffic, find keyword opportunities and low-CTR pages, check indexing, and submit sitemaps on request.

plugins.name: loomascale-gmc
plugins.description: Fix Google Merchant Center product disapprovals and feed errors, review Shopping performance, and update product data on request.
